name: scr1be/hyva-mega-menu
description: Mega menu for Magento 2 + Hyvä 1.4 — one server-rendered menu tree relocated between a desktop Miller-column dropdown and a mobile drawer accordion

suggest.hyva-themes/magento2-default-theme: 1.4 or newer. The module replaces this theme's header menu blocks; without a Hyvä theme the menu renders but inherits no Tailwind build, and its module.css uses Tailwind 4 directives (@source) that the 1.3 line's Tailwind 3 toolchain does not understand
